files.item.md:
**Watering hours change on 1 June**

From 1 June, the city allows watering only before 9:00 and after 18:00. The full notice is on the [city's website](https://example.org/parks/watering?lang=en).

As of 20 May, the city had not announced fines for watering outside these hours.

If a neighbour asks why the hoses are off at noon, you can send the parks office this note:

> Dear [name of your parks officer], our plot at [plot address] follows the new hours. Could you confirm whether drip irrigation counts as watering?

[Sign up for the work day on 14 June](https://garden.example/workday?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email) and bring your own hose fittings.

Dana Whitfield, garden coordinator
